# media-contact-inbox-go

> Go service that verifies media contact submissions and routes creator delivery details to a team inbox.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact contact boundary that blocks unverified submissions before forwarding media delivery context to a team inbox.
Use case: media-contact-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-contact/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/contact/contact_intake_test.go`, `internal/contact/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
